title: baccharis myricifolia var. xylophylla
intro: Baccharis myricifolia var. xylophylla, commonly known as Mountain Silver Burr Sagebrush, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This shrub is traditionally used in folk medicine for its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, providing relief from various health issues. The Mountain Silver Burr Sagebrush is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's health benefits include wound healing, antiseptic properties, and relief from digestive issues and respiratory infections.
